item.title: 'We would run it so good': Is Trump hinting at taking over New York City and Washington?
item.description: Donald Trump suggested the federal government might seize control of New York City and Washington D.C., citing concerns about crime and ineffective local leadership. He criticized New York's ranked-choice voting and claimed the White House possesses the authority to intervene in cities if necessary. Despite data showing a decrease in violent crime in D.C.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ICC issues arrest warrants for two top Taliban leaders; Taliban calls it 'nonsense'
item.description: The International Criminal Court has issued arrest warrants for Taliban leaders Haibatullah Akhundzada and Abdul Hakim Haqqani, accusing them of gender-based persecution against women and girls in Afghanistan since August 2021. The Taliban dismissed the warrants as baseless, while the ICC highlighted the deprivation of fundamental rights and freedoms imposed on women and girls.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Russia blacklists Yale University in latest crackdown
item.description: Russia has labelled Yale University an "undesirable organisation", authorities said Tuesday, as the Kremlin pursues a crackdown on critics that has accelerated during Moscow's campaign in Ukraine. The US university joins international organisations and nonprofits such as Amnesty International, British Council, Greenpeace, Elton John's AIDS Foundation which Moscow has labelled as undesirable.

‘Abandoned the Jews’: Trump takes a jab at democratic senator Chuck Schumer; says AOC will ‘beat him’
item.description: Donald Trump, in a recent jab at Chuck Schumer, misidentified him as a "Palestinian senator" who has "abandoned the Jews." Trump also predicted Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez would defeat Schumer in a future election, referencing potential challenges to Schumer's position. This came amidst Schumer's criticism of Trump's administration regarding the Texas floods, which Trump dismissed as blame-shifting.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Win for Trump: US supreme court allows for downsizing federal workforce; Thousands already out of work
item.description: The Supreme Court has approved President Trump's plan to reduce the federal workforce, overriding lower court orders. Justice Jackson dissented, warning of potential disruptions to government services and mass terminations. Unions and local governments expressed concern over the impact on essential services, while the Justice Department defended the president's executive authority over agency staffing. The downsizing affects numerous federal agencies.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: SpaceX launches Starlink mission from Cape Canaveral; 28 more broadband satellites added to low-Earth orbit
item.description: SpaceX successfully launched the Starlink 10-28 mission on Tuesday, deploying 28 broadband satellites into low-Earth orbit from Cape Canaveral. The Falcon 9 booster achieved its 22nd flight, landing on the drone ship. Furthermore, Starlink is providing aid to Texas flood victims with free service and enabling basic texting through Direct to Cell satellites in affected counties.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Government is deeply broken’: Elon Musk questions people’s faith in Trump amid Epstein files row; US President dodges question
item.description: Elon Musk, once a supporter of Donald Trump, has questioned Trump's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein case. Musk accused the government of protecting offenders and highlighted the lack of arrests related to the case. He also pointed out conflicting statements regarding the existence of an 'Epstein client list'. Musk later retracted a claim implicating Trump.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Silly’ threat: Netanyahu dismisses Mamdani’s warnings to arrest Netanyahu on entering New York; ‘I’ll get him out’ reassures Trump
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismissed New York City mayoral nominee Zohran Mamdani's threat to arrest him, deeming it "silly." Netanyahu hinted at visiting New York despite Mamdani's stance, while Trump labeled Mamdani a "communist" and threatened federal aid if challenged. Mamdani, a democratic socialist, secured the Democratic nomination and is a critic of Israel and Netanyahu.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ambush on Texas ICE agents: 10 charged with attempted murder; 'not a peaceful protest', says US attorney
item.description: In Texas, ten individuals face charges for ambushing law enforcement near an ICE facility on July 4th, injuring an officer. Dressed in black, the group allegedly fired at officers and vandalized property with anti-ICE graffiti. Separately, a man in McAllen opened fire at a Border Patrol facility, injuring another officer before being killed.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Violations of fundamental rights': ICC cracks down on Taliban; Supreme Leader, Chief Justice named
item.description: The International Criminal Court has issued arrest warrants for Taliban leaders Haibatullah Akhundzada and Abdul Hakim Haqqani, accusing them of crimes against humanity. These warrants cite the systematic persecution of women, girls, and those defying the Taliban's gender policies in Afghanistan since August 2021. The ICC emphasizes the deprivation of fundamental rights and freedoms through discriminatory decrees and edicts.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Swift proved to be a special challenge': Kamala Harris tasks Doug Emhoff to reach out to pop star for 2024 campaign, book reveals
item.description: Doug Emhoff, Kamala Harris's husband, was tasked with securing Taylor Swift's support for the 2024 campaign, a new book reveals. Despite Emhoff's connection to Swift's attorney, she only offered a social media endorsement, disappointing the Harris camp.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Years of inaction, minutes of terror: Over 100 dead in Texas flood. Was this preventable?
item.description: Kerr County faces scrutiny after a devastating flash flood claimed over 100 lives during the Fourth of July weekend. A CNN investigation reveals the county's failure to implement basic emergency alert systems, despite repeated warnings and available funding. The lack of sirens and real-time communication with the National Weather Service contributed to the tragedy, prompting criticism of systemic inaction and avoidable loss of life.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'My laptop is a bomb': US Air Force veteran makes midair threat; triggers emergency landing in Florida
item.description: An Allegiant Air flight from Florida to Virginia made an emergency landing after passenger Taj Malik Taylor, recently discharged from a psychiatric facility, allegedly claimed his laptop was a bomb. The incident occurred shortly after take-off, prompting the pilot to return to St Pete–Clearwater airport.

item.title: Visa runs explained: How to legally extend your UAE visa without overstaying
item.description: Need more time in the UAE without breaking the law? Visa runs let you exit and re-enter, extending your stay legally. Whether it’s a simple border trip to Oman or a flight to a nearby country, this method is a safe and cost-effective solution. Just ensure your eligibility and keep your documents in order to avoid fines or complications.
